subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should OpenClaw change the default terminal tool-error behavior so exec-like failures with no delivered reply surface a safe warning or incomplete-turn fallback despite lastToolError, and should this issue remain the combined tracker for that policy?
rationale: The remaining source gaps are real, but the best fix requires a maintainer choice about replay safety, sensitive tool-error disclosure, and how this issue composes with the open placeholder and incomplete-turn trackers.

options.title: Keep this as combined policy tracker
options.body: Use this issue to decide and validate the no-reply exec/tool-error behavior while linking the narrower placeholder and incomplete-turn reports as related evidence.

options.title: Split to narrower canonical issues
options.body: Move placeholder-only work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and incomplete-turn/replay work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657, then close this only after both are resolved.

options.title: Defer behavior change pending live repro
options.body: Require a current-main live reproduction before changing warning or fallback policy, accepting that source-level gaps remain visible for now.

recommendation.title: Keep this as combined policy tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide and validate the no-reply exec/tool-error behavior while linking the narrower placeholder and incomplete-turn reports as related evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shallow history points to vincentkoc as the recent area contributor for the extracted helper files, making them the best routing candidate from available provenance.
